title: Complete Localization Quality & Language Integrity Audit

architecture.header_footer_pipeline: cache -> scripts/build_locale_ui.py -> locale-ui.js, drift-checked by scripts/audit_locale_ui.py (Phase 2)
architecture.body_content_pipeline: cache -> one-off historical scripts -> static committed locale/*.html, NO regeneration or drift detection
architecture.root_cause_statement: Body content has no mechanism to re-sync already-translated static HTML when the English source text changes; this produced both F1/M1 and F2.

findings.title: 'Order on WhatsApp' stale CTA text
findings.root_cause: English source renamed 'Order on WhatsApp' -> 'WhatsApp Inquiry'; governed cache updated with translations of the new string for all locales; 830 already-translated locale pages never re-synced and kept shipping the old English text.
findings.fix: scripts/fix_stale_ui_strings.py: single governed-cache-driven script, validated cache coverage for all locales before writing, replaced the exact stale fragment in all 830 files.
validation_methods: real-browser check all 11 languages, 0 console errors, 0 failed requests
regression test: reintroduced defect on 1 file, confirmed new audit check flags it, restored fix

findings.title: Stale product-page FAQ block leaking English across all 84 products x 10 locales
findings.root_cause: Same mechanism as F1: English root product FAQ content was substantively rewritten (current English root has zero matches for 'Minimum order is 1 FCL' or 'We accept LC' -- confirmed via direct grep); locale pages still carry the retired FAQ content, partially translated at the time, never re-synced.
findings.reason_not_fixed: No governed translation exists for any of these strings in any locale; the underlying English content has been retired/replaced, so a mechanical cache-driven fix (the F1 pattern) is not available without new human translation, which this phase's rules do not permit generating via machine translation.

findings.title: wa-fab floating-button aria-label identical to English in governed cache for 7/10 locales

locales_already_correct.th: WhatsApp JFT การเกษตร

findings.reason_not_fixed: Ambiguous whether 'Agro' should transliterate given the site's own brand-preservation convention for 'JFT Agro Overseas'; 3-locale precedent is not sufficient basis to auto-apply a transliteration to the other 7 without native review.

findings.title: Cache entries identical to English source (heuristic-filtered)
findings.methodology: scripts/audit_localizations.py check_cache_self_identical(): flags cache[locale][source]==source where source contains a common English function word or is 4+ words.
findings.reason_not_fixed: Manual sample inspection found the majority are legitimately preserved (company names, shipping lines, port names, grade/HS codes, prices, dates); reported as an informational metric for human triage, not a hard finding, to avoid mass false positives.

findings.title: Calculator explainer sections exist only in English across all 3 calculators, all 10 locales
findings.reason_not_fixed: Content-completeness gap (section absent, nothing to mistranslate), a content-ownership decision rather than a mechanical translation fix.

findings.title: Byline/caption text left in English inside a translated article body
findings.text: JFT Agro Editorial • Bill Of Lading Review At An Export Terminal

audit_tooling_fix.why_it_missed_m1: ENGLISH_SENTENCE residue check requires 5+ words AND a common function word AND 4+ qualifying sentences per page; 'Order on WhatsApp' (3 words, no function word) was structurally invisible to it regardless of occurrence count.

additions.purpose: Detect locale-page component text/attributes that don't match the governed cache translation of the current dominant English value, for empirically-verified closed-vocabulary components.
additions.regression_test_method: Reintroduced 'Order on WhatsApp' on vi/green-mung-beans-exporter.html; audit correctly reported {'vi_a.btn-wa-product': 1}; fix re-applied; audit clean again.

additions.purpose: Flag cache entries where translation equals English source and the source reads as ordinary prose, as an informational metric for human review.

coverage_table.methodology: cache entries per locale vs. union of all 7115 distinct English source strings across all locales (upper-bound estimate; some strings are locale-specific by design)

metadata_localization_check.jsonld_translated_sample: confirmed on ar/1121-basmati-rice-exporter.html (WebPage, BreadcrumbList, FAQPage all field-translated; FAQPage answers carry the F2 defect)

browser_validation.tool: Playwright, Chromium (msedge channel), headless, local HTTP server (not file://, not static inference)
